hero.title: The future of learning starts here
hero.lead: A new, revolutionary platform to create, share, and master knowledge – tailored for students, teachers, and parents. And best of all: It’s free.
hero.guestNote: Guests join via shared links to lessons/Spaces.
hero.imageAlt: Illustration of a teacher and student using 321skole

landing.trustLine: Ready for schools, courses, and adult education—without heavy LMS friction.

teachers.title: Create more, faster and better
teachers.description: A practical learning management system that helps you produce, adapt, and share learning content—without losing control of quality and level.
teachers.imageAlt: Teacher planning lessons on a laptop
bullets: Create texts in any language and level (write, paste, or generate).
Generate and edit many task types (MCQ, open answers, writing tasks).
Get auto corrected submissions and generate AI supported feedback.
Export finished lessons as both digital lessons and PDF.
Create reading tests with immediately feedback.

students.title: Learn faster, better and smarter
students.description: Generate own lessons, check your level and exercise with AI powered tools like translation, sound and immediately feedback in multiple languages.
students.imageAlt: Student learning a language with headphones
bullets: Create own lessons in any level.
Lessons with adjustable audio speed—both for the main text and translation.
Instant feedback on writing (learning language + optional second language).
Explanations that help you improve—not just right/wrong.
Find your level. Create reading tests with immediately feedback.

parents.title: Support learning smarter and better
parents.description: Support, practice, and follow progress with powerful tools designed for everyday use at home.
parents.imageAlt: Student learning a language with headphones
bullets: Create your own tasks, lessons, and family Spaces.
Check level and track development over time.
Practice reading together with audio, translation, and reading tests.
Explanations that help you improve—not just right/wrong.
Give personal feedback with simple star ratings
Find your level. Create reading tests with immediately feedback.

spaces.title: One room for everything happening in learning
spaces.description: Share lessons, collect submissions, and follow progress—for classrooms, courses, and adult education.

cards.title: Share in seconds
cards.text: Give students a link or code. They land right in the lesson.

cards.title: Anonymous or logged in
cards.text: Low barrier at the start—secure login when you're ready.

cards.title: Overview and flow
cards.text: Everything together: texts, tasks, answers, and feedback—clear and tidy.

whyAi.title: AI as an assistant. Not the answer key.
whyAi.description: This is pedagogical AI: You decides the content, and AI helps with language, level, and variety. Students get explanations—not shortcuts.
checks: Full control: everything can be edited and adjusted.
Safe support: focus on learning, understanding, and progress.
Multilingual from the ground up: text, tasks, audio, and feedback.
